observation.trust_scope: externally assumed physical roots and source-group budget; untrusted nominal centres are metadata

private.noise_scope: global clean norm below E for all offered repeats

finite_restriction.scope: exact optimum only for the declared complete finite deterministic-response model; restriction supplies a lower bound only

verification.scope: independent Helly predicate, exhaustive batch costs, bottom-up minimax and full tree traversal

physics.scope: valid finite restriction of the full continuous contract; completeness is not established by sampling

search.meaning: all cheaper offered exact-reference bundles exhausted for this sufficient family; equal-cost ties need not be exhausted

upper.scope: continuous response-uniform nonadaptive policy UB; not a finite forecast or a lower bound on physical cost

decision.scope: continuous physical contract: checked finite restriction gives LB; response-uniform subset policy gives UB; None UB means unknown

final_observation.trust_scope: externally assumed physical roots and source-group budget; untrusted nominal centres are metadata
